item.title: Two pilots killed in New York runway collision, Trump deploys ICE to strained airports - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: NEW YORK/ATLANTA (Reuters) —Two pilots died in a runway accident that shut New York's LaGuardia Airport on Monday and President Donald Trump deployed armed immigration ​agents to help ease long security lines at major airports strained by personnel shortages.

item.title: Iran denies talks with US after Trump postpones strikes on power grid - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: WASHINGTON/JERUSALEM/TEL AVIV (Reuters) — Iran denied on Monday that it had engaged in negotiations with the United States, after President Donald Trump postponed a threat to bomb Iran's power grid because of what he described as productive talks with unidentified Iranian officials.

item.title: SAAM proclamation signing ceremony set for March 27 - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: (NMCADSV) — The Northern Marianas Coalition Against Domestic & Sexual Violence, alongside community partners, invites the public to attend the Sexual Assault Awareness Month or SAAM Proclamation Signing Ceremony on Friday, March 27, 2026, at 10 a.m. at the Royal Taga Ballroom, Saipan World Resort.

item.title: New law provides tax credit for legal donations - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang last week approved House Bill 24-24, which gives businesses a tax credit for donating cash contributions to non-profit legal services organizations to help low-income residents who cannot afford to hire attorneys.

item.title: Faisao warns of risks to Indigenous cultures from AI initiatives - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: CNMI cultural practitioner Melvin L.O. Faisao is urging the U.S. Department of Health & Human Services’ Administration for Native Americans to provide clear safeguards around data to protect Indigenous cultures from artificial intelligence.

item.title: Dolphin Restaurant serves final lunch buffet ahead of Grandvrio closure - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: DOLPHIN Restaurant on the 10th floor of Grandvrio Resort Saipan served its last lunch buffet on Sunday, ahead of the hotel’s temporary closure on March 31, 2026.

item.title: Saipan Chamber: EVS-TAP is a secure, effective, and essential program for NMI economic stability - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: (SCC) — The Saipan Chamber of Commerce has submitted a letter to the U.S. Secretaries Markwayne Mullin of the Department of Homeland Security, Marco Rubio of the Department of State, and Doug Burgum of the Department of the Interior, providing additional context and clarification regarding the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands Economic Vitality & Security Travel Authorization Program or EVS-TAP.

item.title: Camacho highlights PSS, invites federal official to see CNMI - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: THE commissioner of education for the CNMI Public School System, Dr. Lawrence F. Camacho, briefly met with the U.S. assistant secretary for elementary and secondary education, Kirsten Baesler, on the sidelines of the Council of Chief State School Officers Legislative Conference in Washington, D.C.

item.title: Public gets rare look at CNMI’s founding documents - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: THE original documents that established the U.S. Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands went on public display Tuesday as part of the Commonwealth Jubilee, a three-day celebration marking the 50th anniversary of the Covenant.

item.title: Judge denies AP Energy motion to stop CUC solar project process - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: THE Superior Court has rejected AP Energy LLC’s attempt to pause the Commonwealth Utilities Corporation’s evaluation of proposals for a major solar-and-battery project, ruling that the company was properly disqualified for failing to submit mandatory audited financial statements.
